test_title: PYST 55: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.

He is so __stingy__ that I have never seen him spending money on basic necessities.
solution:
The correct answer is Option 2 i.e.** "Extravagant".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Stingy**: (कंजूस) - Unwilling to spend money; parsimonious; frugal.

 
 
• **Example**: He is too stingy to buy a new car.
 
 
 
• **Extravagant**: (फिजूलखर्च) - Spending more money than necessary in a wasteful manner.
